name: FFXIV Super Addon
description: Raid planning, static reference cards, market lookups, and shareable prep boards for Final Fantasy XIV communities.
author: Community

fallbackBehavior.title: FFXIV panel unavailable
fallbackBehavior.message: The addon is registered, but this build is missing the built-in FFXIV reference panel.

security.threatNotes: Uses public XIVAPI and Universalis endpoints only. Requests are opt-in and channel-scoped; the addon should not be used to store secrets, paid account data, or commercial media assets.

capabilities.notes: Built for static reference lookups, community raid prep, and pinned board state.
